records.title: Synthesis and characterization of hemp and flax fiber reinforced geopolymer composites
records.notes: Layered hemp fabric reached reported flexural strength 7.9 ± 0.2 MPa versus control 3.0 ± 0.1 MPa; orientation matters. Sealed 60 °C/24 h then 14 days aging; five specimens per group.
records.limitations: Activator split and fabric quantity unresolved. Text says sodium pellets rather than sodium hydroxide and gives an inconsistent molarity preparation; do not reproduce as instructions. Reported preload and ASTM/three-point method need review.

records.title: Sodium-based, geopolymer foamed composites reinforced with phosphate mine waste particulates and hemp/basalt fibers
records.rights: Publisher labels Open Access; specific reuse license not observed
records.notes: Untreated hemp and silane-coated basalt, both 12.7 mm; fibers 1 or 5 wt% of slurry plus waste. Waste 5–15 wt% of slurry. Cure 50 °C/24 h then ambient and drying. Higher fiber content can raise thermal conductivity; basalt showed better interfacial bonding in this system.
records.limitations: Different coatings confound fiber-family comparison. Table uses S1 identifiers whereas methods use WP: resolve before linking numerical rows. No complete recipe extraction.

records.title: Investigation on Flexural Behavior of Geopolymer-Based Carbon Textile/Basalt Fiber Hybrid Composite
records.rights: CC BY 4.0 notice on PDF page 1
records.notes: Metakaolin-based commercial cement, silica fume, chopped basalt and carbon textile. Basalt dose is mass percent of geopaste, not total mortar. Textile specimens cured at 22 °C/55% RH to 28 days. More fiber reduced workability; longer fibers clustered.
records.limitations: PDF parsing includes duplicated peer-review headers: version/layout check pending. Mortar compression/flexure and textile four-point/impact results are separate specimens. No scaling or numeric observation ingestion.
